question: I completed 15-211 (Fundamental Data Structures and Algorithms). Does this count as equivalent to 15-210 (Parallel and Sequential Data Structures and Algorithms) for downstream CS requirements?
expected_answer: Yes — 15-211 is listed as an equivalent of 15-210 in the course catalog. A student who completed 15-211 should satisfy any requirement or prerequisite that calls for 15-210.
reasoning_type: Course equivalence — older and newer course versions
common_mistake: Assuming older course numbers are no longer equivalent when the university has marked them as equivalents; not knowing to check the 'equiv' field in the course catalog
needs_verification: Confirm 15-211 is still listed as equivalent to 15-210 in current catalog
Confirm 15-211 is still offered (or was offered when the student took it)
Confirm the equivalence applies to all downstream courses that require 15-210
